title: ERP Head / Technical Lead – University ERP & Digital Platforms
description:
**Experience:**
5–6+ years relevant experience

**Team Leadership:**
Experience leading a 10–15+ member multidisciplinary technology team

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Qualification:**
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field.

**Role Overview**

The ERP Head / Technical Lead will own the end-to-end technology, development, delivery and operations of the University’s ERP and associated digital platforms.

The role combines technology leadership, product ownership, full-stack architecture, DevOps, stakeholder management, quality assurance, integrations and user enablement. The candidate will act as the key bridge between University management, academic/educational institutional processes, and the technology team, while maintaining sufficient technical depth to review architecture, code, infrastructure and production releases.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Frontend, Backend, QA, Functional Support and Training teams; plan priorities, sprints, resources and delivery timelines.
* Engage with University management, department heads, colleges, academic/educational stakeholders and administrative teams to understand requirements, processes and operational challenges.
* Translate institutional, academic and administrative requirements into functional specifications, technical roadmaps and actionable development plans.
* Own the complete ERP product lifecycle—requirement, design, development, testing, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Coordinate frontend/backend development, integrations and dependencies to ensure timely and functionally complete delivery.
* Establish strong QA, testing, release and production-readiness processes, including review of critical changes before deployment.
* Oversee DevOps and infrastructure including CI/CD, Linux/server environments, databases, backups, load balancing, storage, monitoring, scalability and production reliability.
* Oversee integrations with payment gateways, biometric devices, communication platforms, APIs and other third-party systems.
* Drive ERP training, user on boarding, documentation, feedback and support to ensure effective adoption across departments and colleges.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, new modules, process simplification, performance enhancement and improved user experience.
* Support technology procurement, vendor evaluation and infrastructure planning when required.
* Oversee technology development and maintenance of University websites, college portals and associated digital platforms.

**Technology & Platform Landscape:**

The role will oversee a multi-platform technology ecosystem serving academic and educational institutions, including:

* **Application Stack:**
  Centralized Python/Django backend, Next.js web applications and Flutter mobile application.
* **DevOps & Environments:**
  Staging and production environments, Jenkins-based CI/CD, release and deployment management.
* **Infrastructure:**
  MinIO object storage, database clustering with ProxySQL, multiple backend instances and load-balanced architecture.
* **Integrations:**
  Biometric devices, payment gateways, IVR/SIP, WhatsApp Business (WABA), email services, ID-card printing systems and planned POS integrations.
* **Digital Platforms:**
  Student, Admission, Careers and Admin/Employee Portals; Performance & Appraisal, Events, Lead Management and other academic/administrative ERP modules.
* **Extended Scope:**
  University website, college sub-websites, new ERP modules, integrations and emerging digital services.

**Required Technical & Leadership Competencies**

* 5–6+ years of relevant experience in software engineering, ERP/product development, technology delivery or enterprise digital platforms, preferably within academic/educational institutions, universities, colleges or other complex institutional environments.
* Proven experience leading a 10–15+ member multidisciplinary technology team.
* Strong full-stack architecture understanding with hands-on exposure to Python/Django, React/Next.js, REST APIs and relational databases.
* Working knowledge of mobile application architecture, with Flutter experience preferred.
* Strong practical understanding of CI/CD, Jenkins, Linux, deployment, load balancing, object storage, database clustering/proxying, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
* Ability to review and challenge system architecture, code, technical designs and infrastructure decisions and drive scalable, maintainable solutions.
* Experience managing third-party/API integrations, particularly payments, communication platforms and devices.
* Strong product ownership, project execution, prioritization and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Ability to translate management objectives, academic requirements and institutional processes into clear technical roadmaps and measurable deliverables.
* Experience with University/Education ERP or complex multi-department academic/educational platforms will be highly desirable.

**Leadership Expectations:**

The successful candidate should be:

* Technically hands-on enough to review designs, diagnose critical issues and make informed architecture and release decisions.
* Comfortable working directly with management, academic leaders, department heads, administrative teams and end users.
* Capable of balancing new development, live-system operations, support, training, security and system stability.
* Focused on building a strong internal team through documentation, knowledge transfer and structured training.
* Able to establish clear ownership, quality standards, release discipline and measurable delivery practices.

**Success in the Role**

Success will be measured by:

* **Predictable and timely delivery**
  of ERP modules and enhancements.
* **Stable, secure and scalable**
  production and staging environments.
* Improved
  **software quality and reduction in production issues**
  .
* Strong alignment between
  **management priorities, academic/educational processes and technology execution**
  .
* High levels of
  **user adoption, training effectiveness and support responsiveness**
  .
* Continuous strengthening of the
  **technology team, architecture and digital capabilities**
  .

title: AI CERTs Tech Lead
description:
**Role Overview**
 We’re looking for a Tech Lead to own the architecture and engineering direction of the product platform while leading the team that builds and maintains it. This role combines deep technical ownership — architecture, code quality, system design — with people leadership and client\-facing technical communication, as we strengthen our in\-house engineering capability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own the technical architecture of the product LMS platform (Moodle\-based and custom)
* Design and evolve backend services using Node.js, PHP, or Python, and frontend using React.js
* Define and evolve microservices and REST API architecture
* Own Azure infrastructure design and management
* Design and maintain database architecture (MySQL/PostgreSQL)
* Implement and maintain SSO and authentication standards (OAuth 2\.0, SAML, JWT)
* Lead integrations with a wide range of third\-party and enterprise systems (LTI tools, CRM, payment gateways, analytics platforms, and other partner systems)
* Own CI/CD pipelines and containerization for the platform
* Drive system design decisions for scalability and reliability
* Lead code reviews and set engineering standards across the team
* Own technical documentation and manage vendor handover processes
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for client\-facing discussions, translating business and partner requirements into technical solutions
* Manage, mentor, and grow a team of engineers, including performance and career development
* Own cost and vendor\-spend decisions for the platform, evaluating build\-vs\-buy trade\-offs to reduce reliance on paid third\-party tools


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field; equivalent practical experience is welcome.

title: Python Developer_4+ years
description:
We are looking for a skilled
 **Python Developer with hands\-on experience in GenAI, FastAPI, LangChain, and LangGraph** 
 to develop scalable and production\-ready AI applications.
   

  

 The candidate will work on
 **LLM\-based applications, RAG solutions, conversational AI, and agentic workflows** 
 , along with enterprise API and system integrations. The role requires strong backend development skills and the ability to independently deliver high\-quality solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Design and develop scalable REST APIs using FastAPI.
* Develop GenAI and LLM\-powered applications using Python.
* Build LLM workflows and integrations using LangChain.
* Design and orchestrate AI agents and state\-driven workflows using LangGraph.
* Develop RAG\-based applications, including retrieval, embeddings, and prompt orchestration.
* Build conversational AI solutions such as chatbots and virtual assistants.
* Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, databases, APIs, and knowledge bases.
* Work with Azure cloud services, including Azure OpenAI, App Services, and Functions.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with backend, UI, DevOps, and other engineering teams.
* Follow best practices for coding, testing, version control, and production deployment.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience in Python development.
* Hands\-on experience with FastAPI and REST API development.
* Strong experience with LangChain for LLM orchestration.
* Hands\-on experience with LangGraph for agent orchestration and state\-based workflows.
* Experience developing GenAI / LLM\-based applications.
* Experience with RAG and prompt engineering.
* Good understanding of REST APIs and microservices architecture.
* Experience integrating APIs and backend services.
* Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases and Git.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Azure OpenAI and Azure cloud experience.
* Microsoft Agent Framework.
* Microsoft 365 Agents SDK.
* Conversational AI / chatbot development.
* Agentic AI workflows.
* Vector databases and embeddings.
* Docker/containerization.
* CI/CD and DevOps practices.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in
 **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering** 
 , or a related field.

title: Senior SAP CX/C4C Consultant
description:

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ Years
 



**Location:** 
 Gandhinagar, Gujarat
 



**Department:** 
 SAP Consulting
 


 About the Role
 
 We are looking for a highly experienced
 **SAP C4C Lead Consultant** 
 with 10\+ years of SAP CRM/CX experience to lead SAP C4C engagements, solution design, implementations, integrations, enhancements, and support projects.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong functional and solutioning expertise in SAP C4C, excellent client\-facing skills, and proven experience in leading consulting teams and delivering complex SAP CX solutions.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 * Lead end\-to\-end
 **SAP C4C / SAP Cloud for Customer** 
 implementation, rollout, enhancement, and support projects.

 **SAP C4C functional lead and subject matter expert**

* Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP C4C solutions.

* Design and oversee configuration of SAP C4C across
 **Sales and Service** 
 processes.

 .

* Strong experience in
 **SAP C4C implementation, configuration, enhancement, integration, and support**

* Strong understanding of CRM business processes, particularly

 .

* Ability to independently analyze complex requirements and provide appropriate solution options.
